text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Appearance is good to go,
and my expression is picture-perfect!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yup, Curren is super cute today too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha, did you figure it out?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because today is an important race.
I need you to see with your own eyes
just how far Curren can run.
